messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Take amlodipine exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Follow all directions on your prescription label and read all medication guides or instruction sheets. Your doctor may occasionally change your dose.
Amlodipine is usually taken once per day.
Take the medicine at the same time each day, with or without food.
Shake the oral suspension (liquid). Measure a dose with the supplied measuring device (not a kitchen spoon).
Amlodipine for oral solution (Sdamlo) comes as a powder that you must mix with water to make a liquid (solution) before taking or giving it. Throw away Sdamlo if you do not take or give it within 60 minutes of mixing and get a new bottle. Do not store mixed Sdamlo.
Your blood pressure will need to be checked often.
If you have high blood pressure, keep using amlodipine even if you feel well. High blood pressure often has no symptoms.
Do not change your doses or stop taking any of your medications without your doctor's advice.
Your treatment may also include diet, exercise, weight control, and blood tests.
Triplet: ["Amlodipine", "has monitoring requirement", "blood pressure check often"]

The relation 'has monitoring requirement' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject's health condition requires regular assessment or testing as specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'requires monitoring of': Patients taking the subject drug may need the medical test or monitoring specified by the object entity.
B. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
C. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'should inform doctor about': Patients taking the subject drug should tell their doctor about the condition or circumstance specified by the object entity.
E. 'requires patient adherence to': Patients must consistently follow the lifestyle or treatment regimen specified by the object entity to achieve optimal outcomes.
F. None of the above.
